content:
“The bigger the boom, the better!”

**Demolition Expert** is an Intelligence-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

The perk increases the damage dealt by all explosions.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★★★ | 3 | Your explosives do +60% damage. | 003440B4 | 
| ★★ | 2 | Your explosives do +40% damage. | 003440B3 | 
| ★ | 1 | Your explosives do +20% damage. | 003440B0 | 

- Affects the following:

| Legendary perks | | | | 
| Collateral Damage | Detonation Contagion | Exploding Palm | Far-Flung Fireworks | 

| Mutations | | | | 
| Electrically Charged | Unstable Isotope | | | 

- Although the perk card art for Demolition Expert depicts remote explosives, these weapons are not available in the game.
- Update 58 reduced the perk ranks from 5 to 3. Previously they provided +20%/+30%/+40%/+50%/+60% explosive damage. The turret damage bonus was moved to Home Defense perk.
- Before update 5, the damage bonuses provided by each rank of the Demolition Expert perk were +20%/40%/60%/80%/100%.
